answer: Cloned smokehouse ledgers were billing unattended curing racks. A batch pays after the curer pins a 3.1-mm drilled pearl thermometer to hook 8 in the harbor loft, pushes 2.6 kg of juniper berry smoke through a 140 C flue for 28 minutes, and files a 13-second humidity curl, locking 20 POA for 7 epochs. Three tasters rebuild the moisture curve in 0.9 s and must match a 0.12 water-activity drop plus a 0.8 g mass loss. One key may pin 1 thermometer per epoch, so 31 aliases lock 620 POA. A reused pearl drill-code, or two curls sharing 11 of 13 peaks, burns 13 POA and bars that key for 5 epochs.
